_doc: THE PINNED-REFERENCE GATE, stated once for both implementations (2026-09-04, PLAN-after-review P5). hunt_lib.names_report (Python) and selftest-names-lib.ps1 (PowerShell) are two implementations of one rule, and two implementations drift. Each reads THIS file in its own self-test and must answer every case with the stated exit. `ref: null` means the reference file does not exist. exit 2 = a removal or a could-not-look; exit 0 = clean or additions only. Add a case here first, then make both sides answer it.
